title: Preview: changing pictures from their menu, and the .piclist
events: Turn off updating the PDF after each change, and print, so there is a preview to click in
Right-click the picture at JON 1:3: make it span the columns, then put it at the bottom
JON 1:4: to the right of its column, and a line bigger
The whole page picture at JON 2:10: at the bottom of its page
Awkward: shrink the picture whose image is missing (JON 3:4)
Move the spanning picture at JON 1:6. Verse 3 already has a picture, so OK stays greyed out until we choose verse 7
Save, and print with the changes
